_comment: What each page says when somebody pastes its link somewhere.
Crawlers do not run Blazor, so the landing card's tags are written by hand into
wwwroot/index.html and the rest are stamped into per-route shells at publish time by
tools/New-ShareShells.ps1. This file is the one list both of those agree with, and
ShareCardTests fails if index.html and the '/' entry here drift apart.
There is deliberately no og:url and no canonical link: a shared address carries the seed,
the locks and the re-roll counters, and a crawler should keep them rather than collapse
every generated site onto the home page.
Change 'baseUrl' if the public host moves, and re-export the cards afterwards, because the
address is printed in the artwork as well.

cards.title: FLAIL! Tools - Unofficial adventure site generator
cards.description: An unofficial browser-based location generator for the FLAIL! tabletop roleplaying game.
cards.imageAlt: FLAIL! Tools - Unofficial adventure site generator. An original ink-drawn folded map on paper. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.

cards.title: Adventure sites - Unofficial FLAIL! Tools
cards.description: Roll a dungeon, a cave, a wizard tower or a hexcrawl location for FLAIL!, each one drawn its own map. Lock the parts you like, roll the rest again, and share a link that rebuilds exactly what you saw.
cards.imageAlt: Adventure sites - Unofficial FLAIL! Tools. An original ink-drawn folded map on paper. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.

cards.title: The dice table - Unofficial FLAIL! Tools
cards.description: Roll where the whole party can see it: To Hit pools, saves at or under an attribute, and anything else in ordinary notation. The dice go straight between browsers, with nothing hosted and nothing stored.
cards.imageAlt: The dice table - Unofficial FLAIL! Tools. An original ink drawing of a twenty-sided die beside a six-sided die on paper. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
